description.value: Mean Poutine is a family-run takeout-only poutine and hot dog shop founded in 2011 by a former BC Lions football player in Vancouver's Granville entertainment district. The restaurant serves gourmet poutines with handcrafted recipes and a variety of toppings, including vegetarian options, and has since expanded to New Westminster and Ontario. With no indoor or outdoor seating, it is strictly a walk-up counter service spot suited to cyclists needing a quick, filling meal on the go.
